critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated testing reports no confirmed violations, no horizontal document overflow, no touch-target violations, a reachable 158×46 px skip-link target, keyboard traversal through the navigation, and reduced-motion behavior with no transform or opacity animation. However, results remain materially inconclusive at every viewport: 6 serious aria-prohibited-attr nodes, 2 critical duplicate-id-aria nodes, and 484–553 serious color-contrast nodes. These unresolved checks prevent WCAG readiness from being established.
critique.fix: Resolve the prohibited ARIA attributes and duplicate IDs, then measure every flagged foreground/background color pair and correct failures to WCAG AA contrast. Re-run axe until these checks produce conclusive passes at all three viewports; also retain regression tests for keyboard order, visible focus, skip-link activation, touch targets, overflow, and prefers-reduced-motion.
